groups.text: A group is a crew of people around one activity. It has its place, its usual time and members who know each other. A newcomer sees what they are joining before asking for membership, and the group's events are never created from scratch.
groups.title: Groups: a crew that meets regularly

hero.text: Organizers show how many people they still need to reach the minimum. One of the free seats could be yours. And a crew that clicks can keep meeting as a group.
hero.title: Fill the missing players before the event is cancelled

step1.p1: The organizer says how many people they still need to reach the minimum, and everyone sees it right away: in the list, on the map and on the event card. You are not asking “whether”, you are asking “where one more fits”.
step1.p2: When there is no suitable event, you create one in a minute: activity, place, time and how many of you it takes to play.
step1.subtitle: Where players are missing to the minimum.
step1.title: Find an event short of players. Or create one.

step2.p1: Free seats look like chairs at a table, in the list and on the map. One tap asks to join, and you can add a few words for the organizer.
step2.p2: You can browse everything without an account. You sign up when you want to take a seat.
step2.subtitle: One tap, the organizer gets a message.
step2.title: Ask for a free seat

step3.p1: The organizer sees who is asking and approves whom they want. Once the minimum is met, the event goes ahead and nobody travels for nothing.
step3.p2: Approved participants get the exact address and practical instructions, and see who they are going with.
step3.subtitle: Minimum met, the event goes ahead.
step3.title: The organizer approves and you play

step4.p1: People who clicked stay together as a group. It has its place, its usual time and members who know each other.
step4.p2: Nobody creates the next event from scratch, and a newcomer sees what they are joining before asking for membership.
step4.subtitle: Next time nobody starts from scratch.
step4.title: The crew becomes a group
